name: UnderGirl: Submission Path
source: UnderGirl is a femdom 2D visual novel with fighting elements. You play as a young guy, surprised to see a cute girl as your first opponent in an underground fighting tournament. Now, you face a choice: defeat her with ease, or step onto the Submission Path. Which will you choose?
